scene: Inside the rumbling cab, neon flickers replace the depot outside.
beats: Static crackles into lively jazz that syncs with passing sparks. The tow truck brakes inside the buzzing Neon Sign Hospital, its passenger door popping wide.
A glowing glass pretzel radiates warm light from within the tin. The truck pulls up beside colourful glass-bending benches and the door swings smoothly open.
The driver winks, handing you a bent neon lightning bolt souvenir. The truck rolls through the garage doors into Neon Sign Hospital, opening up to welcome you.
picture: Flat side-view cutaway of the truck cab. On the far left, a glowing green radio sits on the dashboard. In the left-centre, the player sits in an orange jacket with telescope and prosthetic leg. In the centre rests a closed tin lunchbox. On the right, a friendly overall-clad driver steers.
shown: a bulky retro radio glowing green on the dashboard on the far left
a dented tin lunchbox sitting shut on the centre seat
a cheerful mechanic in greasy overalls steering on the right

variants.scene: The cosy truck cab hums softly as twilight city lights glide past outside.
beats: Crisp jazz snaps through the speakers, matching the street's flashing signs. The tow truck halts inside Neon Sign Hospital and clicks its door open.
Inside sits a warm, glowing glass pretzel that softly lights the cab. The truck slows by bright glass-shaping tables, and the passenger door pops open.
With a grin, the driver gives you a neon glass lightning bolt. The truck glides through the garage into Neon Sign Hospital, its door unlocking.
variants.ride_on: You skip the hospital stop, riding along dim backstreets to the depot. Swapping into a buzzing sidecar motorbike, you chug toward Midnight Radio Repair beneath towers of warm glass valves.
